aboutPage.heroTitle: A Legacy of Faith, Devotion & Divine Grace
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: For generations, Sankashta Mata Mandir has been a beacon of hope, a home of peace, and a sacred space where countless devotees have found solace in the divine presence of Maa Sankashta.
aboutPage.storyP1: Sankashta Mata Mandir was established with a divine vision — to create a sacred sanctuary where every devotee could seek the blessings of Maa Sankashta, the remover of obstacles. What began as a humble shrine has, through decades of unwavering faith and community support, grown into a revered spiritual destination.
aboutPage.storyP2: The temple stands as a living testament to the power of devotion. Every day, hundreds of devotees visit to offer prayers, participate in aarti, and experience the profound peace that permeates this sacred space. The temple's traditions have been lovingly preserved and passed down through generations of priests and trustees.
aboutPage.storyP3: Today, Sankashta Mata Mandir continues to serve as a spiritual anchor for the community — hosting festivals, conducting poojas, distributing prasadam, and extending seva (selfless service) to all who come with faith in their hearts.
aboutPage.missionText: To preserve and propagate the sacred traditions of Maa Sankashta, serve all devotees with love and humility, and create a spiritual sanctuary where faith, peace, and community flourish.
aboutPage.visionText: To be a timeless beacon of devotion, where every soul who enters finds peace, every prayer is heard, and every heart is touched by the divine grace of Maa Sankashta.
aboutPage.value1Text: Unwavering devotion to Maa Sankashta and the timeless traditions of our temple.
aboutPage.value2Text: Selfless service to all devotees, without distinction, always with love and humility.
aboutPage.value3Text: Bringing people together in devotion, celebration, and shared spiritual growth.
aboutPage.value4Text: Maintaining the sanctity of our temple and the sincerity of every ritual.
aboutPage.timelineSubtitle: Milestones that shaped our temple's sacred history
aboutPage.timeline1Text: A small shrine was consecrated by devoted villagers, marking the humble beginning of Sankashta Mata Mandir.
aboutPage.timeline2Text: With growing devotee numbers, the temple was expanded with a larger sanctum and community hall.
aboutPage.timeline3Text: Daily free prasadam and annadan seva was initiated, serving hundreds of devotees every day.
aboutPage.timeline4Text: A grand festival marked 40 years of devotion, drawing thousands of devotees from across the region.
aboutPage.timeline5Text: The temple launched its digital presence, bringing darshan and seva to devotees worldwide.
